Name: Outside ACE Hospital
Description: Rain pours on the dark streets outside ACE Hospital. High walls loom above you, and an unsecured ventilation terminal sits nearby.

Name: Main Lobby
Description: A clean lobby with modern clinical decor. Security sweep cameras track movements across the main entrance.

Name: Emergency Room
Description: Littered with patient dividers and diagnostic monitors. Guard patrols inspect medical stations regularly.

Name: Lobby Vents
Description: A dusty, cramped maintenance duct directly above the main reception floor.

Name: Employee Hallway (Level 1)
Description: A hallway requiring security credentials. Overhead optical scanners sweep back and forth.

Name: Employee Hallway (Level 2)
Description: A secure restricted corridor. Power distribution panels connect to this floor.

Name: Employee Hallway (Level 3)
Description: Deep facility level. Warning alerts reflect off reinforced doors leading to the core data vault.

Name: Power Room
Description: A room humming with transformer modules. Interfacing with power lines here can disable local grids.

Name: Mainframe Door
Description: A heavy blast door locking down the server room entrance.

Name: Server Room
Description: Cold racks storing facility databanks. The server interface terminal hums in the center of the room.

Name: Power Room Vents
Description: A ventilation pipeline passing directly over active generator rigs.

Name: Mainframe Room Vents
Description: High-altitude duct systems tracking over core database servers.

Name: Maintenance Room Vents
Description: A damp ventilation trunk with vertical utility ladders leading to the building's roof line.

Name: Maintenance Room
Description: A dark utility basement. Dripping steam pipes have coated the concrete floor in condensation.

Name: Rooftop Access Corridor
Description: A secure maintenance passage directly below the helipad under open sky.

Name: Rooftop Helipad
Description: The high-elevation landing deck of ACE Hospital. Automated defensive turret grids monitor the landing perimeter.
